changelog: v0.1.2-beta: Pure-TS Embedded Database Engine (/data/brokeify.db) with zero native C++ addons (eliminates exit code 139 SIGSEGV)
Multi-stage Docker image (~80 MB total, 3.2 MB app bundle) with Chokidar /music drive & NAS watcher and EBU R128 -14 LUFS normalizer on Port 3487
Added Connect Android App section with high-contrast QR code, temporary connection token, Copy Server URL button, and link to github.com/Mr-Nickey/brokeify-android
Added Docker Compose & NAS Drive Setup Guide overlay when no audio files are detected in /music
